verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack describes a MoonPay automation feature, let alone versioning, review, or rollback of automations. A payments/ramp platform could plausibly offer automation rules, so the axis applies, but no such capability is documented. Webhooks, test mode and the sandbox are related features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
